    edit "inside"
        set vdom "root"
        set interface "router"
        set vlanid 3902
        set forward-domain 1
        set description "Toward the servers"
        set icmp-send-redirect disable
    next

config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set srcintf "outside"
        set dstintf "inside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "circuit-all"
        set auto-asic-offload disable
        set comments "Into the servers"
    next
    edit 2
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "circuit-all"
        set auto-asic-offload disable
        set comments "Out of the servers"
    next
end
config firewall policy6
    edit 1
        set srcintf "outside"
        set dstintf "inside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "circuit-all"
        set auto-asic-offload disable
        set comments "Into the servers"
    next
    edit 2
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "circuit-all"
        set auto-asic-offload disable
        set comments "Out of the servers"
    next
end
